# Hypersign — Identity Infrastructure for Modern Compliance

> Full-stack identity infrastructure — KYC, KYB, AML screening, biometrics, consent management, encrypted identity vaults, and reusable verifiable credentials in one platform.

Hypersign is a full-stack identity platform covering KYC, KYB, AML screening, biometric verification, consent management, encrypted identity vaults, and reusable verifiable credentials. It is built for compliance teams and product teams in fintech, banking, crypto, and regulated industries. Hypersign is eIDAS 2.0, GDPR, and India DPDP compliant and supports identity verification in 189+ countries.

## Product

- [Platform Overview](https://hypersign.id/platform): End-to-end identity infrastructure — document capture, biometrics, KYC/KYB, AML, consent, and reusable credentials in one integrated stack.
- [ID Verification](https://hypersign.id/platform/id-verification): OCR, MRZ extraction, VIZ parsing, and fraud detection across 189+ countries and document types.
- [Biometric Verification](https://hypersign.id/platform/biometric-verification): Active liveness detection, face-match against document photo, and anti-spoofing (deepfake, masks, screen replays).
- [KYB Platform](https://hypersign.id/platform/business-verification): Business onboarding with company document collection, director verification, UBO mapping, shareholder KYC, and AML monitoring.
- [AML Screening](https://hypersign.id/platform/aml-screening): Real-time sanctions, PEP, and adverse media screening with ongoing monitoring.
- [Reusable KYC](https://hypersign.id/solutions/reusable-kyc): Users verify once; cryptographically signed verifiable credentials are reused across platforms — reducing drop-off and per-user cost.
- [Consent Management](https://hypersign.id/platform/consent-management): Explicit, timestamped consent capture at every verification step with full audit logs.
- [Identity Vault](https://hypersign.id/platform/identity-vault): User-controlled encrypted storage for identity data with GDPR right-to-erasure support.
- [Verifiable Credentials](https://hypersign.id/platform/verifiable-credentials): eIDAS 2.0-aligned, EUDI Wallet-compatible credentials with selective disclosure.
- [Decision Engine](https://hypersign.id/platform/decision-engine): Configurable risk scoring and orchestration across the full verification stack.
- [Transaction Monitoring](https://hypersign.id/platform/transaction-monitoring): Ongoing monitoring for suspicious activity post-onboarding.
- [Age Verification](https://hypersign.id/solutions/age-verification): Privacy-preserving age checks without storing raw identity data.
- [Aadhaar Verification](https://hypersign.id/solutions/aadhaar-verification): OTP-based eKYC and Offline Aadhaar (QR/XML) verification with biometric face match, selective disclosure, and an immutable DPDP-aligned consent trail, built for Indian onboarding.
- [Magic Link KYC](https://hypersign.id/solutions/magic-link-kyc-kyb): Send a verification link to users; no SDK or app install required.
- [White Label](https://hypersign.id/platform/white-label): Fully branded identity verification flows for enterprises.
- [Verified AI & Human](https://hypersign.id/solutions/verified-ai-human): Verify whether an entity is a real human or an AI agent.
- [Login](https://hypersign.id/platform/login): Social, email, PIN, and OTP login in one flow.
- [Selective Disclosure & Zero-Knowledge Proofs](https://hypersign.id/platform/selective-disclosure): Attribute-level consent and zero-knowledge age or threshold proofs, so a verifier gets only the fact it asked for.

## Developers

- [Developer Overview](https://hypersign.id/platform/api): Three integration paths (hosted verification link, embeddable widget, REST API) and the core design principles behind the platform — standards-first, privacy by design, composable APIs, session-based security.
- [Quickstart: Go Live in Minutes](https://docs.hypersign.id/hypersign-id/tutorials/how-to-verify-users-without-any-integration): No-code, shareable magic-link verification.
- [Widget Integration Guide](https://docs.hypersign.id/hypersign-id/tutorials/how-to-integrate-hypersign-id-widget-in-your-app): Embed the Hypersign ID widget in your app.
- [API Reference: Custom KYC Flow](https://docs.hypersign.id/hypersign-id/tutorials/how-to-build-a-custom-kyc-flow-with-the-hypersign-id-apis): Build a fully custom onboarding flow on the REST API.
- [Full Documentation](https://docs.hypersign.id/hypersign-kyc/integrations): Guides, concepts, and API references.

## Solutions

- [Solutions Overview](https://hypersign.id/solutions): Cross-industry identity orchestration for onboarding, compliance, and fraud prevention.
- [Fintech](https://hypersign.id/industries/identity-verification-fintech): KYC, AML, and reusable credentials for neobanks, payment platforms, and crypto exchanges.
- [Industries](https://hypersign.id/industries): Identity infrastructure for banking, insurance, healthcare, real estate, and more.
- [Web3 & Crypto](https://hypersign.id/industries/web3): KYC, KYB, and KYT for on-chain platforms.
- [Global Presence](https://hypersign.id/global-presence): Coverage across 189+ countries with localised document and compliance support.
- [Marketplace](https://hypersign.id/industries/identity-verification-marketplace): Verify sellers, buyers, and gig workers on marketplace platforms.

## Compliance Guides

- [DPDP Consent Manager vs. Consent Management Platform vs. KYC-Embedded Consent](https://hypersign.id/resources/blog/dpdp-consent-manager-vs-consent-platform-fintech): The boundary between DPDP's registered Consent Manager role, general-purpose consent platforms (OneTrust, Consently, ConsentOS, Digital Anumati), and consent captured at the KYC moment — and which a fintech actually needs.
- [DPDP Act Compliance for Fintech KYC](https://hypersign.id/resources/blog/dpdp-act-kyc-compliance-fintech): What India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act changes for a fintech's KYC stack — granular consent, enforced retention and deletion, vendor accountability — mapped to the controls that satisfy it.
- [Your Account Aggregator License Meets DPDP. It Was Never Built for KYC Consent.](https://hypersign.id/resources/blog/account-aggregator-license-dpdp-kyc-consent-gap): Why an RBI Account Aggregator license covers financial-data consent but not the PAN, Aadhaar, and biometric KYC consent gap, mapped point-by-point against DPDP Act obligations, with citations to the Act, Rules, and RBI Directions.
- [cKYC Doesn't Mean "Verify Once" Anymore](https://hypersign.id/resources/blog/ckyc-otp-stale-data-dpdp-problem): Why India's Central KYC Registry doesn't solve re-verification or DPDP-grade consent, and what a credential-based model changes.
- [GDPR and KYC Compliance](https://hypersign.id/resources/blog/gdpr-identity-verification-kyc-compliance): How GDPR's consent, minimization, and erasure requirements apply to identity verification.
- [eIDAS 2.0 KYC Stack Readiness](https://hypersign.id/resources/blog/eidas-2-0-kyc-stack-readiness): What the EU Digital Identity Wallet and eIDAS 2.0 require of a KYC stack.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://hypersign.id/pricing): Starter plan at $500 for 3 months — includes 100 KYC checks, KYB at $20/check, free encrypted storage, and consent infrastructure. Ongoing pay-as-you-go rate ($0.75/verification) is approximately 30% cheaper than Persona and 50% cheaper than Sumsub at meaningful volume; see the worked methodology at hypersign.id/pricing#methodology.
